strings.sp_gui_launch_intro:
SP Flash baarakɛminanw GUI bena bɔ sisan.

• N’a ma faga ka ban, i ka ɔridinatɛri faga.
• N’a be USB la, a bɔ fɔlɔ.

strings.support_methods_subtitle: I ka nili kɛcogo min ka di i ye, o sugandi. Nilifɛn kelen kelen bɛɛ be wari di ka minanw telesarse, k’u ladon ani k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ.
strings.support_methods_title: Dɛmɛ be se ka kɛ cogo minw na
strings.support_story_1_body: Innioasis be to ka porogramu kuraw bɔ tulonkɛlaw kama i n’a fɔ Y1 (minw ɲɛsinna board dogoninw yɛlɛmaniw ma i n’a fɔ 6.0, 7.0 ani 8.0) minw be minan kɔrɔw tiɲɛ nɔgɔman na. Min ka jugu n’o bɛɛ ye, u ka site web tɛ lasɔmini foyi di ani u tɛ se ka porogramu kɔrɔw sɔrɔ minw tun be baara kɛra walisa ka se ka bɔ briki cogoya la. Lakurayali ani Community Firmware poroze be fɛnw ta: an be ROM kɔrɔmanw bɛɛ mara, an b’i ka minanw yɛlɛmani sɛgɛsɛgɛ o yɛrɛ ma ani an b’a to i ka tulonkɛla be baara kɛ lafiya la.
strings.support_story_1_headline: Ni dilanbagaw be taga ɲɛfɛ, sigidamɔgɔw be wuli.
strings.support_story_1_item_1: Ka tulonkɛlaw kisi minw tiɲɛna: Lakanali sɛgɛsɛgɛri b’a to yɛlɛmani kuraw tɛ minan kɔrɔw tiɲɛ abada.
strings.support_story_1_item_2: ROM minw marala: Innioasis ka porogramu fɔlɔw bɛɛ lajɛnnin lo.
strings.support_story_1_item_3: Platform min be sɔrɔ yɔrɔ caaman na: Baarakɛminanw be se ka yɛlɛma macOS, Linux ani Windows bɛɛ kan.
strings.support_story_1_item_4: Hardware Intelligence: A be tablo lɔn a yɛrɛ ma walisa i ka pake ɲuman sɔrɔ tuma bɛɛ.
strings.support_story_1_lead: Ka i ka minan tanga ka bɔ nɛgɛjuruw ma ani yɛlɛmani tiɲɛninw ma.
strings.support_story_2_body: Ka Innioasis porogramu ofisiyɛli nɔfɛtagama, a ka ca a la, o kɔrɔ ye ka forɔmuw sɛgɛsɛgɛ ka Google Drive ka yɔrɔw sɛgɛsɛgɛ minw ka wagati banna, Baidu ka sankaba tilanyɔrɔw salenw ani zip file gundomanw minw tɛ ni baarakɛminanw ye minw be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma. An ye réseau dɔ lɔ min be se ka la a la ani a be se ka telesarse a yɛrɛ ma ani a be ni SHA-256 tilenninya sɛgɛsɛgɛnin ye, a be kunnafoni kuraw di ani a be mɔgɔw bilasira yɔrɔ o yɔrɔ. I ka nilifɛnw be fɛɛn minw telesarse ani k’u mara, o lo b’a to o be se ka kɛ lɛrɛ 24 kɔnɔ tile kɔnɔ, tile 365 kɔnɔ saan kɔnɔ.
strings.support_story_2_headline: Google Diskw tiɲɛnin tɛ. Miiri-baara tɛ. Lozisiyɛli fitinin dɔrɔn lo be baara kɛra.
strings.support_story_2_item_1: Direct High-Speed ​​CDN: A be se ka telesarse joona ani a tɛ se ka telesarse dan ani a tɛ yɔrɔ salenw sɔrɔ.
strings.support_story_2_item_2: Ladilikanw kurakurayali: Ni jamakulu ka fɛɛn kuraw bɔra wala n’u labɛnna, i ka lasɔmi.
strings.support_story_2_item_3: Installation guidée étape par étape: Yirali gwɛninw b’i dɛmɛ ka butɔnw digi tuma o tuma.
strings.support_story_2_item_4: Kan caaman fɔbagaw ka jɛnkulu: A be fɔ Angilɛkan, Sinuwakan, Alemaɲikan, Ɛsipaɲikan, Faransikan ani Zapɔnkan na.
strings.support_story_2_lead: Sigida baarakɛminɛnw minw ka teli ani u sɛgɛsɛgɛra, i be se k’i jigi la u kan tiɲɛn na.
strings.support_story_3_body: I ka Y1 wala Y2 ka minanw be se ka min kɛ, porogramu minw be sɔrɔ iziniw kɔnɔ, u b’o lo sɛgɛsɛgɛ dɔrɔn. An ka sigida ye Rockbox, operatɛri nɔgɔmanw, kodɛki minw be lamɛn ani barokun minw be mɔgɔw lasun u ka koow kɛ, olu lawuli. An be minanw yɛlɛmaniw san an ka wari kɔnɔ walisa k’u sɛgɛsɛgɛ, k’u yɛlɛma ani k’u donyɔrɔ bɛɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛ. Ka Lakurayali dɛmɛ, o be wari di o kɔrɔbɔli yɔrɔw ma ani ka porogramu fitininw labɛn joona joona.
strings.support_story_3_headline: Ka i ka Innioasis tulonkɛla ka setigiya bɛɛ dayɛlɛ.
strings.support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox min be digi yɔrɔ kelen na: Odiofiliw be se ka lamɛn ani ka barokunw don i ka ɔridinatɛri kɔnɔ sekɔndi damanin kɔnɔ.
strings.support_story_3_item_2: Sigida lozisiyɛli fitinin: Batiri yiriwali, UI saniyanin, ani bi tile kodɛki lamɛntaw dɛmɛni.
strings.support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: An be sɛgɛsɛgɛri kɛ minan yɛrɛ yɛrɛw kan sanni an ka boon si bɔ.
strings.support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware: 100% lozisiyɛli min be sɔrɔ gwansan, a be mɔgɔ ka kunnafoniw mara fɔlɔ ani a tɛ pibilisitew wala mɔgɔw nɔfɛtagama.
strings.support_story_3_lead: Ka na ni Rockbox ye, baarakɛcogo nɔgɔmanw, ani lamɛnnikɛlaw ka hɔɔrɔnya.
strings.support_story_4_body: Ni minanw dilanyɔrɔ dɔ be taga n’u ka minan wɛrɛ ye, u be minan kɔrɔw to yen. Innioasis tɛ Linux dɛmɛ foyi di, yɛlɛmaniw be kɛ cogo gwɛnin na ani cogo nɔgɔman tɛ yen min be se k’a to i be se ka yɛlɛma n’i ka installation ma ɲɛ. Lakurayali be yen sabu baarakɛlaw minw be baara kɛ ni kanuya ye, olu man ɲi ka miziki fɔlan ɲuman dafanin dɔ fili. Sigida ka bolomafara 100% be taga yɔrɔnin kelen ka baarakɛminɛn nin dayɛlɛ bɛɛ ye.
strings.support_story_4_headline: Innioasis tɛ min kɛ, an dɛmɛ k’o kɛ.
strings.support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: A sɛgɛsɛgɛra ko kɛnɛyali be kɛ hali ni minanw banna ka baara kɛ.
strings.support_story_4_item_2: Linux ka dɛmɛ fɔlɔ: MediaTek min be yɛlɛmayɛlɛma Linux distros kan, o be dɛmɛ dafalen di.
strings.support_story_4_item_3: Yɛlɛmani minw be kɛ, u be gwɛ: U be bɔli sɛbɛw kɔnɔ ka gwɛ walisa i k’a lɔn tigitigi yɛlɛmani minw be kɛra.
strings.support_story_4_item_4: 100% Jamana ka wari: Kafe kelen kelen bɛɛ be sɛbɛnw marayɔrɔ dayɛlɛ ani bɛɛ be se k’u sara gwansan.
strings.support_story_4_lead: Sigida ka lozisiyɛli fitinin marali min b'i ka minanw mara nɔgɔw bilayɔrɔw la.

strings.themepack_complete: Theme pack donna ka ɲɛ! Sisan, i be se k’i ka tulonkɛlan tigɛ hɛɛrɛ la ani ka barokun dɔ sugandi Rockbox kɔnɔ (Paramɛtiriw > Barokunw ka paramɛtiriw).

3. N’u y’a ɲini i fɛ i ka USB Storage mode sɛgɛsɛgɛ walisa o minan ka bɔ i n’a fɔ diski.

strings.themepack_step2_desc: Komi operatɛriw (i n’a fɔ macOS) be dotfiles (i n’a fɔ .rockbox) dogo u yɛrɛ ma, i be se ka dosiye SUGU wala diski lili sugandi i ka tulonkɛlan kan. An bena .rockbox yɔrɔ sɔrɔ wala k’a dilan i ye o yɛrɛ ma.
